snippet.title: Yoshi for Nintendo Switch - Official Game Trailer - Nintendo E3 2017
snippet.description:
Yoshi heads on a new adventure in this new action platforming game coming to Nintendo Switch. Explore a great big world decorated like a miniature diorama, look for items throughout the stages and team up with a friend in a new art style for the franchise. Learn more: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/yoshis-crafted-world-switch/
